_about: Interface assumptions for the ghost chassis and the driver's lower legs (LEFT side; mirrored for the right). Context only: the chassis is out of scope, but the steering rack, column, ARB and pushrods must clear these envelopes. mm, vehicle axes (x fwd, y left, z up).

driver_left._note: 95th-percentile-ish legs: heel rest 150 mm behind the front axle, feet up to the pedal faces at x = +75; pedal box ahead of that. These place the low front rack under the pedal faces.
driver_left.pedal_box_note: 2026-11-08: narrowed from +/-170 to +/-150 mm. The side rails' inner faces were at 162 mm, so the old box overlapped the assumed chassis itself; found when the chassis tabs became parts the sweep checks against it. The upper side rail (mid_front, mid_rear) also moved 10 mm inboard, to y 170: with the upper wishbone bolts tilted towards it (normal to the leg, for the rod ends' misalignment), heads and tools 25-35 mm from it had no room

_chassis_note: Rails sit 25-35 mm from the suspension pickups and the verticals sit clear of them, so pickup brackets have room (rod-end head radius 12 mm + tube radius 12.7 mm). Top rail inboard of the rocker. Upper rail moved to y 170 on 2026-11-08 (see driver_left.pedal_box_note).
